rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a blastocyst and the provided 2AA label, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM/TE quality and frames Day-5 grade 2 as more concerning than standard Gardner criteria support; some described details are not clearly discernible from the image alone.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior IVF outcomes, sperm motility, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is structured and generally logical, with a clear link from embryo and patient factors to prognosis, though some quantitative adjustments are somewhat speculative and may over-penalize smoking/BMI.

Many recommendations are standard and evidence-based, but several suggestions are weakly guideline-supported or controversial for this scenario (ERA, NK/immunologic workup, thrombophilia screening after only a biochemical pregnancy, routine PGT-A emphasis in low-yield cycles).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer support, lifestyle counseling, and future-cycle considerations, though some proposed investigations may be more extensive than typically indicated.
